normalizations: Outlined PDF: original.pdf has no text layer; every English line is a manual transcription from 300 dpi renders, kept as printed, source slips included (source/intake.py names the physical page of each block).
Shared Manual IR: content.json is replayed through the shared flow renderer and shared components. No package class, inline style or plain table (prepared-document shared-style gate).

Print weights: bold print runs stay strong; headings keep print case. Printed list markers (a., a), 1), 1., --) are kept as text on their own printed lines; the LCD callout legend 1-15 is an ordered list.

Line ends inside a paragraph are wraps; printed lines that start a new statement stay line breaks. Line-end hyphen splits tempera-/ture, connect-/ed and transfer-/able are rejoined; repeated spaces collapse.

Figures are source drawings cropped from the print; words drawn in the art stay in the art and the alt text carries them. Inline LCD pictograms in run-in subheadings are this print's own pixels (8x, alpha).
Cover (p1) is not Web content; the back cover (p11) becomes the closing contact section; the 'US' page tabs and folios are not content.
